recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-20209 unless Pharmacy later reopens the broader MedicationDispense.receiver target list.
issue_request: FHIR-20209 is a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to add RelatedPerson to MedicationDispense.receiver so a dispense can record pickup by a caregiver, family member, or similar related person. It was raised against STU3 and applied for R5.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-20209. The same semantic change was applied through the earlier Published tracker FHIR-19693: Jira cites merge commit aa42e5dcc1e780bf1fa001dc784d2801f6d3b1d4, whose implementation commit 9d4a0fe09370e2b75ede4debcff124f36c3d3d7e changed MedicationDispense.receiver from Reference(Patient|Practitioner) to include RelatedPerson and Location.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active in source/fhir.ini. Later receiver-family decisions did not reverse the RelatedPerson support: FHIR-19698 added PractitionerRole, FHIR-50109 added Organization and updated the definition, and FHIR-42843 rejected Person while affirming RelatedPerson for someone other than the patient or practitioner. Community searches found no FHIR-20209-specific contrary discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active StructureDefinition already lists RelatedPerson in MedicationDispense.receiver targetProfile, and no additional source wording is needed for implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published tracker requested RelatedPerson on MedicationDispense.receiver and names the applied aa42e5d commit.
Same 2019 receiver-target implementation added Location after deciding not to add Organization/HealthcareService at that time.
Later Published decision added PractitionerRole to the same receiver element and comments also support RelatedPerson for parents/spouses.
Resolved - No Change request for Person affirmed RelatedPerson as the correct receiver representation for non-patient/non-practitioner pickups.
Applied R6 decision added Organization and matching definition text without disturbing RelatedPerson; it is already represented on the combined branch.
